newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Yields keep falling on Bulgaria discount T-bills.
newsitem.headline: Yields keep falling on Bulgaria discount T-bills.

text.p: Yields fell further at Thursday's auctions of Bulgaria's Finance Ministry one-week and four-week discount T-bill issues, central bank figures showed.

The average yields to maturity of the two issues were 2.75 percent and 14.96 percent, respectively, down from 3.04 and 15.49 percent on Wednesday, 3.23 and 15.93 on Tuesday and 3.44 and 16.24 at Monday's auctions.
Bids were received for a total of 124.676 billion levs of T-bills for today's auctions but the ministry approved bids for 62.875 billion levs worth of paper.
The issues were offered with no par value or minimum acceptable price set in advance by the ministry. Auction date and maturity date for each issue overlap.
The ministry has issued one-week and four-week discount T-bills daily since January 20 to regulate banks' liquidity.
Details of the issues follow. Prices in percent of par:
Bids received 59,223.2 million levs 65,452.8 million levs
Bids approved 25,111.7 million levs 37,762.8 million levs
Avg yield to maturity 2.75 pct 14.96 pct
